title: 230V AC RESISTIVE DROPPER, 4 BLUE LEDS
purpose: Mains 230 V AC illumination: series dropper resistor, half-wave series diode, 4 blue chip LEDs in series, anti-parallel diode protecting the LED string from reverse voltage, wire solder pads for L and N.

parts.role: L wire solder pad 1 (red wire), at right board edge
L wire solder pad 2 (second pad per client drawing, strain relief)
series dropper from L, limits LED current to 2.1 mA avg / 6.6 mA peak, dissipates 0.51 W half-wave (1.02 W worst single fault)
parts.rating: 2 W, 350 V max working voltage, non-flammable metal oxide film

parts.role: series half-wave rectifier, blocks the negative half-cycle (325 V peak vs 1000 V VRRM); DO-41 chosen because its 8.7 mm pitch keeps >=3 mm between its HV anode and LV cathode pads (SMA pads are only 2.4 mm apart)
parts.rating: VRRM 1000 V, IF(AV) 1 A, IFSM 30 A

parts.role: chip LED 1 of 4 in series, front side on 20 mm PCD
parts.rating: IF max 20 mA DC, VF 2.6-3.4 V, VR 5 V
IF max 20 mA DC, VF 2.6-3.4 V, VR 5 V
IF max 20 mA DC, VF 2.6-3.4 V, VR 5 V

parts.role: chip LED 4 of 4 in series, cathode to N
parts.rating: IF max 20 mA DC, VF 2.6-3.4 V, VR 5 V

parts.role: anti-parallel across the LED string (anode AC_N, cathode VLED): clamps LED reverse voltage to one diode drop while D1 blocks
N wire solder pad 1 (black wire), at right board edge
N wire solder pad 2 (second pad per client drawing, strain relief)

qa.result: 6.6 mA peak, 2.1 mA average, 3.3 mA rms (numeric half-wave integration)
qa.source: XL-3216UBC datasheet p.3 (IF max 20 mA); light/01_ELECTRICAL_REVIEW.md section 3

qa.formula: I_rms^2 x R = (3.3 mA)^2 x 47 kOhm
qa.result: 0.51 W half-wave; 1.02 W if D1 fails short (full-wave)
qa.source: CCO MOF datasheet p.13-1 (rated power at 70 C), p.13-2 Table-1

qa.formula: V_rms across R1 = I_rms x R = 155 V; peak 312 V
D2 anti-parallel clamps LED string to -VF(D2) while D1 blocks
qa.source: XL-3216UBC datasheet p.3 (VR 5 V); MDD M7 p.1 (VF 1.1 V)

qa.formula: any downstream short leaves R1 limiting: full-wave P = 2 x 0.51 W
qa.source: CCO MOF datasheet p.13-1 (Nonflammable), light/01_ELECTRICAL_REVIEW.md section 3

decisions: Captain 2026-11-11: R1 = 47 kOhm MOF2WS 2 W (C121703) to match the prototype brightness class; 39 k 3 W was the alternative
Captain 2026-11-11: D2 used as anti-parallel protection diode across the LED string instead of a second series diode
Captain 2026-11-11: SMA M7 diodes (prototype package) rather than DO-41 1N4007 (NRND)
Wire pads: four single-pad test-point devices (two per wire) give free pad spacing for the 3 mm L-N clearance; no library wire-pad device exists
D1 = 1N4007-T DO-41 (C108355): SMA pad gap 2.4 mm cannot meet the 3 mm HV-LV clearance across the series diode; D2 stays M7 SMA (both pads LV)
